name: serafort-react-sdk-workspace
description: Standalone pnpm workspace for the Serafort React SDK: @serafort/react-sdk (headless) and @serafort/react-elements (styled drop-in components). Split out of the boilerplate/ app monorepo so it can be developed, versioned, and published independently of the internal frontend's tier boundaries.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @serafort/react-sdk run build && pnpm --filter @serafort/react-elements run build

comment:typescript: typescript-eslint doesn't support the TS 7.0 native compiler yet (github.com/typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint#10940), so this root-only 'typescript' devDependency pins a TS 6.x instance purely for eslint's parser peer resolution. It does not affect react-sdk/react-elements's own build/type-check, which each resolve tsc from their own local 'typescript7' (real TS 7.0.2) devDependency first.
